Chapter 7177: Divine Beast Original Blood

Chapter 7177: Divine Beast Original Blood

Mighty cultivators in Golden World offered their faith and power. The laws represented everything - their life force, flesh, blood, and dao power...

Golden’s source erupted to the limit, illuminating worlds and empowering the wall. It became thick enough to take on a liquid form, flowing between the cracks. Next, the laws transformed into chains, wrapping and fortifying the defense.

“Divine Beasts!” Divine Firmament also opened up and revealed its bestial resources.

The sea of wisdom emerged with Skykiller Palace inside under Chongming Lord’s control. The survivors poured their vitality and dao powers into the sea, summoning a manifestation of Skykiller True Dragon.

Both the young and old divine beasts offered their everything. The grand momentum blessed for epochs was also activated.

Initially, this grand momentum was meant to help them survive the calamity. Now, Chongming Lord chose to help defend the wall.

“Original Blood!” Chongming Lord commanded everyone to turn their powers into the purest blood.

“Raa!” The dragon roared and spewed the blood through dimensions, reaching the altar inside Desolate Frontier.

The injured immortals who had burned their true blood recovered dramatically.

“It’s still coming!” They roared vigorously.

The next tsunami shook Heavenrealm and cracked worlds. Unfortunately, this meant the death of trillions.

“Keep it up!” The groups led by Empress Hong Tian, Origin Heaven Emperor, Immortal Emperor Qi Zhen, and Nightfall Immortal Monarch continued to strengthen the wall.

“Ahh!” The destruction this time broke a corner of the wall, pulverizing many immortals in that section.

“Stay strong!” Sword Emperor yelled at Immortal Emperor Mu Tian who had a bloody hole in his chest.

Sword Emperor’s state was just as bad. His sword dao had collapsed along with his body.

“We will go as well!” Cultivators from Divine Firmament shouted.

Earlier, it was just the divine beasts at work. Upon seeing this, the dragon servants and regular cultivators chose to stand with the divine beasts once more.

“As one, Divine Beast Bloodline!” They followed the divine beasts’ lead and offered their cultivation to the sea of wisdom. This made the original blood purer and more powerful.

At the same time, a maelstrom formed in Ruin. Immortals appeared and channeled the worldly energies of Ruin into Desolate Frontier.

Since it had just been rebuilt, these worldly energies were in a primitive and unrefined state. Nonetheless, Desolate Frontier’s grand momentum welcomed the additional influx, having depleted considerably to deal with the first waves.

“Count us in!” Apex Immortal and Heaven’s Equal Monarch involved Ancient World. Their overlords and immortals controlled the grand momentum to help Desolate Frontier.

“Crack!” The seal on Stygian loosened, allowing the power of time to rush out. It joined the primordial tree and flowed to Desolate Frontier.

Suddenly, the immortals in the wall became younger and returned to their prime.
